email.subject: Recruiter from Example Corp sent you a message
email.bodyText:
Pooja Iyer, HR Manager at Example Corp, has sent you a message regarding the role Business Analyst (3-5 yrs), Hyderabad.

"Dear Candidate, your profile has been shortlisted. Please share your availability for a telephonic discussion tomorrow between 11 AM and 4 PM."
